xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5261: GitHub GraphQL still at ~44%/hour after PAN-5224: pr-cache polls every 30-60 s, pipeline-membership not webhook-driven

plan.title: GitHub GraphQL still at ~44%/hour after PAN-5224: pr-cache polls every 30-60 s, pipeline-membership not webhook-driven
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After PAN-5224 the user-pool GraphQL bucket still runs at 46.8% (2,339 points in 07:08-08:08 UTC, 2026-11-14). Webhook health is fine (relay running, fresh sample) and the poll tiers run at the healthy rate. The spend is per event: 209 coalescer fires in 55 minutes each re-read the open (3 points) and closed (1 point) PR listing of eltmon/overdeck, 20% of them for CI runs that name no PR; and each of ~60 membership gathers per hour re-asks GraphQL for ~492 issue states (11 calls), partly triggered by the tracker diff reading projected derived state.
narratives.Proposal: Cut the cost of each event and each gather, keep the PAN-5224 tiers: read open PRs at --limit 30 (1 point, re-read 100 when 30 come back); let review/check/status webhooks invalidate only the open read; drop check_run/status webhooks that name no PR and no issue branch; keep the UNKNOWN-mergeable 30 s pin only for issue branches; diff raw tracker rows in the tracker trigger; cache GraphQL issue-state answers for 30 minutes in the dashboard, invalidated by the tracker trigger. Projected user GraphQL in a busy hour like the before window: ~455 points/h from dashboard-owned callers, ~745 (14.9%) including the agent caller; ~150 in an idle hour.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A dashboard webhook-delay indicator: the issue's requirement 2 applies only if webhook health is the cause, and it is not
- Changing the PAN-5224 TTL tiers, the 6 s coalescer spacing or the membership fallback intervals
- Fixing the GitHub App's missing issues permission or the empty open-issue listing (PAN-5263)
- App-pool REST: close-out (PAN-5227) and app-rest attribution (PAN-5264)
- The agent caller's own gh calls
- Caching merged-head answers or spacing membership gathers per project
- Removing or caching the telemetry stage gather in src/lib/telemetry/pipeline.ts
- Issue-state caching in CLI or deacon processes (the cache is opt-in and only the dashboard enables it)
- The repeated membership failures for papers-please, orca and Orbacade (no GitHub calls spent)
- Faster freshness for status events on non-issue PR branches or check runs on fork PRs: they now wait for the fallback TTL
- Deploying the change

autoDecisions.summary: Hypothesis 1 (unhealthy webhooks) is false, so no webhook-delay indicator is built.
autoDecisions.rationale: GET /api/system/health showed the smee-relay row running on a 2 s old sample, and ledger read cadence matches the healthy tier; the issue makes requirement 2 conditional on that cause.

autoDecisions.summary: NFR-1's 15% REST target binds the user pool; App and PAT pools are reported beside it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's target refers back to PAN-5224's user-pool target (D-3 there) and its own sample is the user pool's rate_limit; App-pool spend belongs to PAN-5227 (close-out) and PAN-5264 (app-rest).

autoDecisions.summary: Cut per-event cost instead of lengthening poll tiers.
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured cadence is already the healthy tier; the spend is webhook fires and gathers, and longer tiers would widen lag on repos without webhooks.

autoDecisions.summary: Open read at --limit 30 with a re-read at 100 when 30 rows come back.
autoDecisions.rationale: rateLimit(dryRun: true) priced the exact field set at 3 points for 100, 2 for 50, 1 for 30; the re-read keeps readers on a complete open set.

autoDecisions.summary: The App's missing issues permission is filed as sibling PAN-5263, not fixed here.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fixing it changes membership semantics and raises gather cost (~36 merged-head chunks per gather); it needs its own design.

autoDecisions.summary: No per-SHA deduplication of check_run created events (critique round 1).
autoDecisions.rationale: Each created check adds a distinct pending row read by summarizeTestChecks and readySinceFromRollup; suppressing it would hide a later needs: job from the 10 s freshness bound.

autoDecisions.summary: NFR-1 is checked as an idle-hour total target plus a busy-hour target over every caller except agent, with the total reported.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for idle-dashboard use; the before hour was busy (6 agents, 7 merges) and the agent caller is agents' own gh calls outside dashboard control.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue-state cache is opt-in per process and enabled only by the dashboard read model.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only the process running the tracker-change trigger can drop stale answers; a 30-minute age bound covers a failed tracker poll.

autoDecisions.summary: After-measurement is posted as a PR comment after the Flywheel's pan reload; the PR body carries the before table and recipe.
autoDecisions.rationale: The work agent cannot deploy; same approach as PAN-5224 D-10.

items.title: Open PR read lists 30 rows and re-reads 100 when it may be truncated

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In loadOpenPullRequests (src/lib/overdeck/pr-listing.ts line 175, grep "'pr', 'list', '--state', 'open', '--limit', '100'"), add OPEN_READ_SMALL_LIMIT=30, OPEN_READ_FULL_LIMIT=100, a module Set fullOpenReadRepos and a listOpenRows(projectPath, limit) helper exactly as in the PRD after-snippet. Read at 30 unless the repo is in the set; a 30-read returning >=30 rows adds the repo and re-reads at 100 before settling; a 100-read returning <30 rows removes it. The lastOpenNumbers shrink logic uses the final rows; a thrown re-read settles null via the existing catch. Update module header and cachedOpenPullRequests doc comment. Add the 5 tests listed in WI-1 to the new test file (mock run-gh like pr-listing-webhook-ttl.test.ts, fake timers) and update the 100-row test in derived-issue-state-quota.test.ts (line 102) to expect open@30, open@100, closed.

Coalescer change kinds: status-only webhooks invalidate only the open PR read

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Add invalidateOpenRepoPullRequests(projectPath) to pr-listing.ts next to invalidateRepoPullRequests (line 256): open cache only, includeInFlight, no closedGeneration bump. In pr-webhook-freshness.ts export type PrWebhookChange = 'pr-state' | 'pr-status'; notePullRequestWebhook gains a 4th parameter change defaulting to 'pr-state'; CoalescerEntry stores change: a leading fire uses the event's kind and stores 'pr-status' on the new entry, a merged 'pr-state' event upgrades entry.change, and the trailing timer captures entry.change with issueIds/reasons and resets it to 'pr-status' in the same block (lines 113-120) so the kind never carries into the next window; fire() with 'pr-status' calls invalidateOpenRepoPullRequests for project.path, resolve(project.path) and routed paths and skips invalidateOpenPullRequestsSnapshot; 'pr-state' keeps today's calls. Append the change kind to the [pr-webhook] log line. Add invalidateOpenRepoPullRequests to the test's pr-listing.js mock and add the five WI-3 tests.

Given notePullRequestWebhook is called without a change argument, when it fires, then it acts as 'pr-state', and the existing 6 s spacing tests still pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. In src/lib/webhook-handlers.ts pass the change kind as the 4th argument of notePullRequestWebhook: 'pr-state' in handlePullRequest, 'pr-status' in handlePullRequestReview, handleCheckSuite, handleCheckRun and handleStatus. In handleCheckRun keep coalescerTrigger and additionally require run.pull_requests non-empty or an issue branch in run.check_suite.head_branch. In handleStatus call the coalescer only when ids.length > 0. No per-SHA deduplication (D-6): every qualifying created and failing completed still reaches the 6 s coalescer. Leave every other handler line unchanged. Add the WI-4 tests.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. In src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts after listIssueStatesBatched add ISSUE_STATE_CACHE_TTL_MS (30 min), a module Map keyed lower-case owner/repo#n holding { state: 'open'|'closed'|null, at }, enableIssueStateCache() (returns disable-and-clear), invalidateCachedIssueState(owner, repo, n) and listIssueStatesCached(owner, repo, numbers, list, now) as specified in the PRD: disabled -> pass through; enabled -> fresh entries answered from cache, only the rest sent to list, numbers list omits cached as null and stay omitted; a per-key generation map is bumped by invalidateCachedIssueState, read for each missed key before list runs, and an answer is stored only if its key's generation is unchanged after list resolves (still returned to its caller); a rejected list caches nothing. At line 708 route the gather's issue-state step through listIssueStatesCached(..., deps.listIssueStates). Nothing else in the gather changes. Add the WI-6 tests with fake timers.
